## About

The ComponentOne Pdf library C1.Pdf Library (C1Pdf) is a cross-platform PDF cteating library
that provides APIs that is compatible with .NET Standard 2.x.

All features are fully supported on Windows, macOS and Linux.

C1Pdf provides a set of APIs that allow developers to implement fast and
efficient processing of PDF documents from other sources:

* Programmatically create PDF files, for it.
* Using HTML code or HTML/HTM file format.
* Using RTF code or RTF or DOCX formats.
* Using XLS, XLSX, XLTX and CSV file formats.
